project.name: Muirhead (Freuchie)
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 8 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. The same-name Angus settlement and Little Muirhead on the Pilgrim Way are different places. Freuchie services and Falkland attractions are outside the boundary.
